Late spring brings a careful month
Bravo to the whole team
Paws in Transit, All Set

The Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways is keeping the day-to-day flow steady and kind, and that calm tone matters to travelers and pets alike. We are seeing thoughtful questions, patient follow-ups, and a lot of good teamwork behind the scenes. <<FACT F008>> Clear replies and respectful timing help everyone feel prepared, and that spirit has shown up in every handoff.

This week, the reminder is simple: listen closely, answer warmly, and keep each detail neat. Whether a traveler is checking a carrier note, confirming a comfort stop, or just looking for reassurance, the desk can make the journey feel easier from the start. Pip, Eva Romano, and Rafael Rossi each remind us how much confidence grows when the guidance is steady and human. Thanks to the whole crew for making Aurelia Skyways feel welcoming, organized, and ready for the next smooth departure.
